operations.after:
[$.receiver_parameter, $.scoped_type, $._reserved_identifier],

    // csharp-P2-06: 'extern unsafe ~F()' vs modifiers of another member
    [$.modifier, $._finalizer_extern],
    [$.modifier, $._finalizer_unsafe],

    // csharp-P2-09: 'extern alias X;' in a namespace body vs an extern member whose type is 'alias'
    [$.modifier, $._extern_alias_extern],

    // csharp-P2-01 / csharp-P2-11: contextual 'async' / 'await' stay identifiers until a later token decides
    [$._reserved_identifier, $._lambda_expression_init],
    [$._reserved_identifier, $._lambda_expression_init, $.anonymous_method_expression],
    [$.modifier, $._lambda_expression_init, $.anonymous_method_expression, $._reserved_identifier],
    [$.modifier, $._lambda_expression_init, $.anonymous_method_expression],
    [$._reserved_identifier],
    [$._reserved_identifier, $.await_expression],
    [$.local_declaration_statement, $.await_expression, $._reserved_identifier],
  ],

operations.before:
switch_section: $ => prec.left(seq(
      choice(
        seq(
          'case',
          choice(
            $.expression,
            seq($.pattern, optional($.when_clause)),
          ),
        ),
        'default',
      ),
      ':',
      repeat($.statement),
    )),
